## checks (6)
item_prices|item_prices_check|CHECK (((valid_until IS NULL) OR (valid_until > valid_from)))
sale_items|sale_items_check1|CHECK (((variant_id IS NULL) OR (item_id IS NOT NULL)))
sale_items|sale_items_check|CHECK (((kind <> 'product'::text) OR (item_id IS NOT NULL)))
sale_payments|sale_payments_amount_check|CHECK ((amount > (0)::numeric))
sale_payments|sale_payments_check|CHECK (((received_amount IS NULL) OR (received_amount >= amount)))
stock_movements|stock_movements_quantity_delta_check|CHECK ((quantity_delta <> (0)::numeric))
